en: The postcard is divided into two black-and-white photographic views. The left side shows a church with a tall steeple, cross, and a fenced pathway leading to the entrance. The right side features an aerial view of a school building with large windows, and behind it, a small town nestled among rolling hills. Hungarian text is present at the bottom of each image, identifying the church and the school.
